pair_table.index: pair index = floor(progress / 13); progress = 16-bit word at $D39E (the integer part of the 24-bit route cursor $D39D..$D39F)
pair_table.skipped_frames_between_blocks: $36..$3F (10 frames) are not in the table
pair_table.rule: selector: frame := pair[index][0], except pair[index][1] when pair[index][0] equals the current frame; then record duration $07 := 6

right_3c1b.note: position = saved origin + (x[p], y[p]); p = progress >> 8 read BEFORE the exit test, so a fast exit update may read past $180

left_3dae.note: position = saved origin + (x[p], y[p]); p = progress >> 8 read BEFORE the exit test, so a fast exit update may read past $180

roll_selector.counter: $D52F increments each call and wraps at 20
roll_selector.facing: with floor contact (+$22 bit 1): bit 4 of +$04 is cleared, then set when the X speed high byte ($D517) is negative; in the air (+$22 bit 1 clear) the selector jumps to $8FF0 (not decoded here) with duration 3 and facing untouched
roll_selector.used_by_loop_states: $903D tail-jumps to $8F76 whenever +$03 bit 1 (rolling / attack posture) is set

right_3c1b (state $0C via vector $03CB).per_update: progress += X speed (8.8); position = origin + (x[p], y[p]); p < $90: X speed -= 10 (borrow -> bailout $3CC5); p >= $90: plane := 1, X speed += 12; call $48BC
right_3c1b (state $0C via vector $03CB).exit: p >= $180 -> request state $06 (state $09 when +$03 bit 1), X speed := $D373 (maximum speed), $D3A0 := $10
right_3c1b (state $0C via vector $03CB).bailout: $3CC5: origin X <= current X -> X += 8 else X -= 2, then $4680 (request state $1D)

left_3dae (state $0D via vector $03D1).per_update: progress += -X speed (the speed is negated, so it is positive for a leftward run); tables $86AE / $8A46; p < $90: |speed| -= 10; p >= $90: plane := 0, speed -= 12 (more negative); call $48BC

routes.alt_3cfc (state $13 via vector $03CE): not reached in THZ1 (needs previous foot block $57; THZ1 has no $57 cell); see docs/gpz-loop-route-audit.md

entry_conditions.right_state_0c: current foot block $52, previous foot block $51, plane ($D525 / +$25) 0, floor flag +$22 bit 1 set -> $3EAB
entry_conditions.left_state_0d: current foot block $50 or $51, previous foot block $52, plane 1, floor flag set -> $3EE1 (adds 32 to X before the shared snap)
entry_conditions.no_other_gate: no speed, facing, state or attack test: only blocks, plane and the floor flag (the route itself bails out when slow)
entry_conditions.setup: X &= ~31 (kept in +$3A/+$3B), Y := (Y & ~31) + 4 (kept in +$3C/+$3D), cursor $D39D..$D39F := 0, then POP AF (the terrain pass ends early)
